title: Vivijure Backend
description: The GPU render engine for Vivijure. It rents a high-VRAM GPU by the second to train a per-character face model (LoRA), draw an SDXL keyframe for each shot, turn each still into motion (image-to-video), and finish the result, then hands the video back to the Vivijure Studio control plane. Every model is baked into the image, so there is no build step and no model download. Requires a Cloudflare R2 bucket shared with your Studio.
